sanskrit: jitam asmākam udbhinnam asmākam ṛtam asmākaṃ tejo 'smākaṃ brahmāsmākaṃ svar asmākaṃ yajño 'smākaṃ paśavo 'smākaṃ vīrā asmākaṃ prajā asmākam | tasmān nir bhajāmo 'mum āmuṣyāyaṇam amuṣyāḥ putram | sa grāhyāḥ pāśān mā moci | tasyedaṃ prāṇam āyur ni veṣṭayāmi- -idam enam adhamaṃ tamo gamayāmi ||
english: Ours is the victory, ours the conquest, ours is the truth, ours the splendor, ours the sacred knowledge, ours the heavenly light, ours the sacrifice, ours the cattle, ours the heroes, ours the offspring. Therefore we exclude from his share yonder son of so-and-so, child of so-and-so. May he not be released from the nooses of Grāhī. I wind up his breath and his lifespan — I send him down into the lowest darkness.

sanskrit: jitam asmākam udbhinnam asmākam ṛtam asmākaṃ tejo 'smākaṃ brahmāsmākaṃ svar asmākaṃ yajño 'smākaṃ paśavo 'smākaṃ vīrā asmākaṃ prajā asmākam | tasmān nir bhajāmo 'mum āmuṣyāyaṇam amuṣyāḥ putram | sa mṛtyoḥ paḍvīśān mā moci | tasyedaṃ prāṇam āyur ni veṣṭayāmi- -idam enam adhamaṃ tamo gamayāmi ||
english: Ours is the victory, ours the conquest, ours is the truth, ours the splendor, ours the sacred knowledge, ours the heavenly light, ours the sacrifice, ours the cattle, ours the heroes, ours the offspring. Therefore we exclude from his share yonder son of so-and-so, child of so-and-so. May he not be released from the foot-fetters of Death. I wind up his breath and his lifespan — I send him down into the lowest darkness.

sanskrit: jitam asmākam udbhinnam asmākam abhy aṣṭhāṃ viśvāḥ pṛtanā arātīḥ svar abhyāvarte | sūryasyāvṛtam anvāvarte dakṣiṇām anvāvṛtam | tad agnir āha tad u soma āha pūṣā mā dhāt sukṛtasya loke | aganma svar aganma saṃ sūryasya jyotiṣāganma | vasyobhūyāya vasumān yajño vasu vaṃsīya vasumān bhūyāsam ||
english: Ours is the victory, ours the conquest. We have overcome all hostile forces and all envious ones; we have turned back toward heaven. We turn following the revolution of the sun, we turn following the southern (path). So Agni has said, and Soma has said; may Pūṣan place me in the world of the well-doers. We have reached heaven, we have united with the light of the sun. For the sake of becoming more prosperous, may the sacrifice be rich in goods; may I win wealth, may I be rich in goods.

sanskrit: viṣāsahiṃ sahamānaṃ sāsahānaṃ sahīyāṃsaṃ sahamānaṃ sahojitam | viśvajitaṃ svarjitam abhijitaṃ vasujitaṃ gojitaṃ saṃjitaṃ saṃdhanājitam | īḍyaṃ nāma hvaya indram āyuṣmān bhūyāsam ||
english: I invoke by name Indra the ever-conquering, the conquering, the one who has conquered, the mightiest conqueror, the one won by conquest — the all-conquering, the heaven-conquering, the Abhijit-conquering, the wealth-conquering, the cattle-conquering, the all-winning, the battle-winning — Indra who is praiseworthy. May I be long-lived.
[As 18.54.1, closing with:] May I invoke Indra and become dear to the gods.
[As 18.54.1, closing with:] May I invoke Indra and become dear to my offspring.

sanskrit: viṣāsahiṃ sahamānaṃ sāsahānaṃ sahīyāṃsaṃ sahamānaṃ sahojitam | viśvajitaṃ svarjitam abhijitaṃ vasujitaṃ gojitaṃ saṃjitaṃ saṃdhanājitam | īḍyaṃ nāma hvaya indraṃ paśūnāṃ priyo bhūyāsam ||
english: I invoke by name Indra the ever-conquering, the conquering, the one who has conquered, the mightiest conqueror, the one won by conquest — the all-conquering, the heaven-conquering, the Abhijit-conquering, the wealth-conquering, the cattle-conquering, the all-winning, the battle-winning — Indra who is praiseworthy. May I become dear to my cattle.
